problem_description: PTESTS_PROBLEMS:append:libc-musl:qemuarm64 and PTESTS_PROBLEMS:append:libc-musl:qemux86-64 in meta/conf/distro/include/ptest-packagelists.inc assign values without a leading space. :append does not insert a separator, so the first appended recipe name is concatenated onto the last existing word of PTESTS_PROBLEMS.

The backported 0001-scripts-dtc-drop-yaml-in-DT-validation.patch is added through SRC_URI_RISCV instead of SRC_URI, so only RISC-V U-Boot builds apply it. u-boot-tools and U-Boot for every other architecture never receive the fix the commit message describes.

weston-start tests x"{$weston_modules}" instead of x"${weston_modules}". The braces are outside the dollar sign, so the shell compares a literal string that is never equal to "x", and the modules argument check does not depend on whether any modules were collected.

uboot-sign.bbclass writes UBOOT_FIT_USER_SETTINGS into the ITS file with 'echo -e'. Task shell code runs under /bin/sh, and on hosts where that is dash, echo does not accept -e, so a literal "-e" is written into the generated ITS file. printf is the portable replacement.

The change makes multiprocess_launch() unpack each argument tuple into individual parameters, so runstrip() now takes its arguments separately instead of one tuple. The caller in meta/classes-recipe/kernel.bbclass still passes a single tuple to runstrip() and is not migrated, so kernel stripping breaks.

The upgrade to 78.1 changes the version format from '77-1' to '78.1', but the Python helpers that derive ICU_MAJOR_VER and related values still split PV on '-'. With no '-' in PV, the split yields one element, so ICU_MAJOR_VER is wrong and do_make_icudata's install of icudt${ICU_MAJOR_VER}l.dat fails when PACKAGECONFIG contains make-icudata.
The barebox upgrade removes 0001-lib-lz4-use-lz4-instead-of-lz4c.patch from SRC_URI in barebox.bb but does not delete the patch file from the recipe directory, leaving a dead patch in the layer.

The piglit upgrade adds wayland-related build dependencies (such as wayland-protocols and wayland-native) unconditionally to DEPENDS but not the target wayland package that provides wayland-client, so piglit fails to configure for X11 targets. The wayland dependencies belong behind a PACKAGECONFIG option.

The new make_last() reordering in meta/lib/oe/rootfs.py has no effect: its return value is never assigned back to the post-process command variable. The reordered commands would also be joined without whitespace, so they would run together into one invalid command.

After switching alsa-utils to dynamic package splitting, the recipe still adds alsabat-test.sh explicitly to FILES of the alsabat package. With bat in PACKAGECONFIG, the dynamic split creates alsa-utils-alsabat-test, but the explicit FILES entry takes the script first, so that package is empty and never created.
